subject: [PATCH v5 05/19] selftests/mm: make the swap cases' swapout reliable

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch improves the reliability of swapout operations in selftests/mm by introducing a retry mechanism to handle cases where MADV_PAGEOUT is best effort and khugepaged may still be working on the range. The patch adds a new function `swapout_range` that retries swapping out a range up to two seconds, holding the range out of khugepaged's reach meanwhile. If the pages still won't swap out after retrying, the test will skip this step as it is not a kernel bug. This change aims to fix issues on arm64 with 64K pages where the case loses the race between swapping out and khugepaged collapsing the range.
